title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager: AI-powered regulatory templates from regulation PDFs
summary: Hold: the access guidance implies that per-regulation permissions remove a user's broader Compliance Manager access, but Microsoft explicitly says the broader role remains. The roadmap facts and PDF creation procedure are supported; the two control paths stop early and need their remaining steps.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing
claims.claim: Microsoft plans AI-powered conversion of regulation PDFs into actionable controls and actions in Compliance Manager.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview: Compliance Manager - AI Powered Regulatory Templates; This feature in Purview Compliance Manager shall enable customers to convert complex regulations from PDF documents to actionable controls and actions in multi cloud environment.

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: Customers can use converted templates to create assessments, identify compliance gaps and implement controls.
claims.quote: Customers can use the converted regulatory templates to create assessments and identify compliance gaps, understand and implement controls to improve their compliance posture.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Why it matters; rationale: cost; Open questions
claims.claim: A licence rule specific to PDF-created custom templates is not published.
claims.quote: Searched: Compliance Manager custom PDF templates license Regulation licenses used storage processing AI powered 523209 enable disable. Read create-template, regulations, regulations-list, setup, service description and FAQ licensing excerpt; no PDF-specific entitlement stated.

claims.quote: Searched: Compliance Manager custom PDF templates license Regulation licenses used storage processing AI powered 523209 enable disable. Read create-template, regulations and service description; the counter is documented, but PDF-created templates are not assigned a counter rule.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Meter
claims.claim: The creating-regulation-templates page lists roles and PDF requirements and names no licence or meter.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Meter; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Regulation licenses used on the Regulations page tracks templates in use against entitlement.
claims.quote: The Regulation licenses used counter near the top of the Regulations page represents the number of regulatory templates in use out of the number you're eligible to use according to your licensing agreement and any purchased licenses.
claims.fix: Add after the counter description: 'The Get started page calls these counters Free regulation licenses used/Purchased regulation licenses used.' Both names are documented; retain the existing counter description. See https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/compliance-manager-setup#regulations-page.

claims.fix: Extend controls[0].ui.path and its rendered copy to 'Compliance Manager > Regulations > Create new template > Upload PDF document > Scan and extract > Review draft template > Publish template'. The existing path stops early in the documented creation procedure; applicable services and form fields can remain in the prose.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: Compliance Manager roles assigned in the Purview portal extend by default to all regulations and their assessments according to role type.
claims.quote: their role extends by default to all regulations ... depending on the user's role type, they can view or interact with any existing or future assessments created with that regulation.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Restricting access per regulation is sufficient to narrow the all-regulation access of an existing overall Compliance Manager role holder.
claims.quote: Removing a regulation-based role won't remove the user's overall Compliance Manager role if they have one. If you want to change a user's overall role, you have to change it in the Microsoft Purview portal.
claims.fix: Replace the 'unless you restrict access per regulation' clause with: 'Per-regulation assignments apply at the assigned role level, but removing one does not remove an overall Compliance Manager role; change the overall role in the Microsoft Purview portal.' Replace 'per-regulation access is the narrowing control' with the same qualification. In the rollout checklist, say 'Review per-regulation assignments in Manage user access; also review overall Compliance Manager roles, which removing a regulation-based role does not remove.' Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/compliance-manager-regulations#grant-user-access-to-regulations.
